info.title: apply
info.description: The apply API. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code`.

get.description: Liveness, and whether the database and the file bucket answer.
Is the model reachable, and are the configured models pulled?

put.description:
Use a model found on this machine, after a short test: a server and model just found, and a usable JSON
answer from each chosen model. MODEL_NOT_FOUND or MODEL_TEST_FAILED otherwise, and nothing changes.

get.description: The model servers on this machine (the configured host, fixed ports), their models, and which is in use.

Whether "Create an account" is offered: on the first run (the owner's), then while the owner keeps
registration open. Never with web setup off (accounts are made with `apply init`).

post.description:
Make an account and sign in: the owner's on the first run, anyone's after that while registration is open
(403 REGISTRATION_CLOSED otherwise; 409 EMAIL_TAKEN). Web setup off: `apply init` only.

Email a link to choose a new password, if there's an account with this email. The answer is the same
whether or not there is (202), and the email is sent after it. 409 MAIL_NOT_SET_UP with no SMTP server.
The account a reset link is for, while it works (404 RESET_LINK_INVALID once used or expired).

A new password from a reset link. Every session of the account ends, so the person signs in again; the
link and any other of the account's stop working.

put.description: Open or close "Create an account" on the sign-in page. Existing accounts are untouched.

get.description: Every account on this apply (never what's in them).

delete.description: The account and everything in it, its files in the bucket too. The owner's own can't be deleted.

patch.description: The account's language (the web app also keeps it in a cookie, for before sign-in).

post.description:
A profile made from a document. 202 with the profile, saved at once; the model reads the document into its
fields in the background (``reading.status`` pending → ready, or failed with a code). Poll it, then check
every field. 422 UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE, UPLOAD_UNSUPPORTED, or UPLOAD_NO_TEXT (a scan with no text in it).
A copy of the profile to change what's different ("Name (copy)" unless named), never the default.
Read the profile's document again; what's read replaces its fields. 409 PROFILE_NOT_READ without one.

get.description: The document the profile was made from. 409 PROFILE_NOT_READ without one.

post.description: Paste a link or the text. New: 201; the same link or text again: 200 with the existing one.
Have the model read the opportunity's text again.

get.description: The opportunity (and application, if there is one) for a page: the form the extension is looking at.

delete.description: The application and everything made for it; its posting stays. 409 while Auto is sending it.

post.description: Write a document in the background. 202 with the pending document; poll it until it is ready or failed.

200.description: One is already being written: that one

get.description: Where postings can come from, what each needs, and what its terms ask of us.

post.description: Add a source; it's fetched straight away, then on its schedule.
Which kind of source a pasted address is (a company's job board page), and the config it stands for.
Fetch now (409 SOURCE_TOO_SOON within the interval the source's terms ask for).
Save a search; it runs over what's already here straight away, then on every fetch.

get.description: The inbox: best fit first (unscored last), then newest. Default: new and saved.

post.description: Make it an application (or point it at the one already tracking this job).

get.description: Today's briefing, in the owner's time zone; built at their briefing hour (or POST to build it now).

schema.title: Response Todays Briefing Api V1 Briefings Today Get

put.description: Your own wording: saved as a new version (the one in use) and checked again.

post.description: "It's true" (kept), or open again.

get.description: The version in its template, printed to a tagged PDF/UA-1. 409 RENDER_PENDING (Retry-After) while it's made.
The version in its template, as the page (what's previewed). 409 RENDER_PENDING while it's made.
The template your documents of this kind are made in (yours, or the default), and a sample in it.

put.description: Your own template, kept if it passes every check (422 TEMPLATE_PROBLEMS with the problems if not).

get.description: The default, to start your own from.

post.description: What would stop this template being kept (nothing: it may be), and a sample in it, without keeping it.
The pack's common questions you don't have yet (sensitive ones start as "Decline to answer").

get.description: Everything to apply by hand: where, which documents (and their warnings), the answers.

post.description:
"I've submitted it": what went out is recorded, and the application moves on. With a token, the channel is
the token's (the extension), and the same submission again within the undo window is answered with the first.
Undo, within 10 minutes (UNDO_TOO_LATE after).
A token for the extension. Its secret is in this answer only: apply keeps a hash.

delete.description: Stops working at once. A revoked token stays listed, so you can see what it was.

get.description: Who this is: the extension checks its token here, and speaks the owner's language.
What goes into the application's form: profile values, saved answers, documents (with their PDFs).

A profile's values for the extension's copy panel (the pack's default profile unless one is chosen), each
ready to paste, and the saved answers. Needs a token with profiles:read, or a session.

patch.description: Pause Auto (no new runs, and none prepared further), and its limits.

post.description: Stop preparing it, or take it off Ready for you. Its application and documents stay.
Start again from the gate, once what it needed is fixed. Not after a send (from before) that may have gone.

ready_at.title: Ready At
ready_at.description: When it was prepared: the person's to send from then

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.description: Answers a runner drafted, on runs from before (history)

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: A runner's screenshots, on runs from before

file.title: File
file.description: A resume (or the pack's document): PDF, .docx or text

web_url.title: Web Url
web_url.description: The web app, for links back to it

Caller.title: Caller
Caller.description: Who a request is: the owner, and the token it came with (None for a session).

title.title: Title
title.description: The person's own words for the entry (a job, a qualification), or empty

sensitive.title: Sensitive
sensitive.description: An equal-opportunity answer: shown only after the person asks

CopySheetOut.title: CopySheetOut
CopySheetOut.description: A profile's values, each ready to copy and paste into any form; no profile yet: profile null.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Shown this once; only its hash is kept

DocumentState.title: DocumentState
DocumentState.description: A document in use, or one being written or failed since: enough for a card.

FillSheet.title: FillSheet
FillSheet.description: Everything the extension puts into a form. Sensitive answers go only to the form, never to a model.

Filled.title: Filled
Filled.description: What the extension did to the form: counts and labels only, never the values.

loaded.title: Loaded
loaded.description: In memory now: answers without loading first

usable.title: Usable
usable.description: Writes text; an embedding model can't be chosen

Label.title: Label
Label.description:
One string in each of apply's languages. A label stored before Spanish was added (a saved answer's question,
say) has only English and Nepali, and a Spanish reader sees the English.

milliseconds.title: Milliseconds
milliseconds.description: How long the test took (the first use loads the model)

num_ctx.title: Num Ctx
num_ctx.description: The context size sent (native API); None where the server sets its own

source.title: Source
source.description: Chosen in Settings → Model, or the settings (.env)

Paste.title: Paste
Paste.description: A link to a posting, or its text: one of the two.

PersonOut.title: PersonOut
PersonOut.description: An account, as the owner sees it: never anything in it.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details, with a stable ``code`` the web app translates. ``detail`` is for logs.

ProfileReading.title: ProfileReading
ProfileReading.description:
The model reading the document into the fields: pending, ready, failed (error_code says why), or stopped
(the person edited the profile first, and their edits win).

ProfileSource.title: ProfileSource
ProfileSource.description: The document a profile was made from (download it at /profiles/{id}/source).

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: Add the demo (John Doe, a fictional profile) to look around

Registration.title: Registration
Registration.description: Whether anyone may create an account on this apply (the owner's switch).

ResetFor.title: ResetFor
ResetFor.description: The account a reset link is for (shown, and given to a password manager).

Setup.title: Setup
Setup.description: Whether "Create an account" is offered, and whether it's the first run (the owner's account).
